versions.content: If development error detection for the Fr module is enabled, then the function Fr_GetPOCStatus shall check whether the parameter Fr_POCStatusPtr is a NULL pointer (NULL_PTR). If Fr_POCStatusPtr is a NULL pointer, then the function Fr_GetPOCStatus shall raise the development error FR_E_PARAM_POINTER.
